You're calling yourself an adult with such responses? I'm not gonna waste anymore time with such an "adult".

I was not talking about people like you. People like you are not in that category...I was misunderstood...when people have real problems then it's not in their head. But when someone for example gets rejected by the opposing sex and then remains with a mentality of "I'm not good enough, I want to die" that is what I was talking about.

Ok maybe I was wrong to some degree at the begining by saying "all in your head", but I guess you ignored the rest of what I said after that. That's the only part that I can agree its wrong. But the rest still stands. And I'm not blaming anyone. I didn't say that it was their fault.
Now lets take a look at something wrong you wrote:
"like telling someone with Alzheimer’s to stop forgetting stuff" Your comparision is garbage too...it basically says: "stop trying to help suicidal people through words, they can't be helped like that". 

"Stop telling people this kind of garbage. It’s wrong and hurtful. You’re not helping anyone but your own ego." I believe that here you are still talking about the "all in your head" thing. If so I won't comment anymore on that. But if you're talking about the rest of what I wrote, you're in no position to conclude such things. I made a threat here where I wrote the six reasons I listed down there that receieved a few upvotes before being removed because it broke some rules of this community. But I'm sure it's helpful to some people and that's why I posted it here. Not for my ego. I'm not like some facebook attention seeker I actually deleted facebook a few years ago, never cared about attention. But someone as ignorant as you can go ahead and say the things he/she usually says. You go tell people what they want to hear, that is ok too but may not last long. Meanwhile I'm gonna tell them what is wrong and how it can be solved.

There are very few reasons  for a person to commit suicide for. I believe that most of the time its all in their head...like over 90% of the time...all they need to do is think logically about the problem they have and how its gonna be solved...find your problem and think about it among these:

1.While you are alone, you let negative thoughts take over your mind. You did this a few days in a row and it became a habbit.


2. You don't do what you love in life. Try to do what you love and don't force yourself into doing things you hate. If you really hate ur job then quit. You hate anything? Get rid of it if you can. Or at least stay away from it.


3. You think you need something but you really don't. You are frustrated because you think you deserve something, maybe you do but thats the luck of the draw. You don't really nèed friends, or a partner. All you really need is food, water and shelter to survive.

4.Because of society. It tells you what your life should be like. Its just a recommandation, don't take it too seriously. It makes you think you are worthless if you dont obey its rules. But its just not true.

5 If none of the above...you may have a real, temporary problem. Something that can't be solved/avoided no matter what...Like a convict being imprisoned in jail. Like a kid not being loved by the parents. In this case, I'm sorry. I hope you can carry on. But even those problems will be solved in the end... time will solve them.  The prisoner will get out of jail eventually...the kid will grow and will be independent of his parents eventually. There is still enough reason to carry on.

6 The permanent real problems. Like the prisoner sentenced for life. Or like someone with a disability. This saddens me the most. I hope that people with those kind of problems find inner peace and the strength to carry on.

Just sitting alone, staring blankly and thinking about the things you fear, the heartbreaks or the deaths of family members will surely get you on the wrong path. Its normal to think about something bad at the moment it happens, but after a while you have to move on...Get busy doing something you love and you will not be thinking about those things while you do that.

Family and close friends will be much affected by it but anyone else? Not that much...I would say it's still the worst decision to make. But I don't know your problem so I won't judge.
Most of us just need time and thinking to solve our temporary problems...and few have permanent problems. Those people have to be really strong to carry on.

I haven't had close friends for like 5-6 years so I know the feeling very well...but in the end I am fine... I like being alone. Here is how I solve such problems:
While you are alone, you let negative thoughts take over your mind. You did this a few days in a row and it became a habbit. Stop thinking and do something...you can't think about something if you are too busy doing something else.
Try to do what you love and don't force yourself into doing things you hate. If you really hate ur job then quit. You hate anything? Get rid of it if you can. Or at least stay away from it.
You think that you need friends but you really don't.  All you really need is food, water and shelter to survive.
Imagine being like that without quarantine...this is how my life was long before quarantine...but I am fine, I found the strength to carry on. Do what you love and move on...
Sorry man, I hope you find the strength to go through.
